name: 灌溉用水量估算（蒸发蒸腾）

map.基于作物系数（Kc）与参考蒸散发（ET₀），估算一定时期内作物需水量与灌溉水量。: Based on the crop coefficient (Kc) and reference evapotranspiration (ET0), estimate crop water demand and irrigation volume over a period.
map.ETc = Kc × ET₀；总需水深 = ETc × 天数；净灌溉水深 = m: ETc = Kc x ET0; total water depth = ETc x days; net irrigation depth = max(0, total depth - effective rainfall); volume (m3) = depth (mm) x area (m2) / 1000
map.以作物系数 Kc 乘参考蒸散发 ET₀ 得日需水 ETc，乘天数得时段总需水深（: Multiply the crop coefficient Kc by reference evapotranspiration ET0 to get daily demand ETc, then by days to get the period total water depth (mm). Subtract effective rainfall for net irrigation depth. Multiply depth by area (m2) and divide by 1000 for cubic-meter volume. Convert by mu (1 mu = 666.67 m2) for irrigation quotas and pump scheduling.
map.💡 公式：作物需水量 ETc = ET₀ × Kc；总需水体积 = ETc ×: 💡 Formula: crop water demand ETc = ET0 x Kc; total volume = ETc x days x area / 1000 (m3). After deducting effective rainfall it is the net irrigation demand.
map.ET₀ 可通过当地气象站、FAO Penman-Monteith 公式或蒸散量估: ET0 can be obtained from local weather stations, the FAO Penman-Monteith formula, or an evapotranspiration estimator.
map.Kc 随作物生育期变化，表中为平均值，盛花期/盛果期通常更高。: Kc varies with the crop growth stage; the table shows averages, and peak bloom/peak fruit are usually higher.
map.灌溉效率未扣除输水损失与田间不均匀性，实际引水需结合灌溉水利用系数。: Irrigation efficiency does not deduct conveyance loss and field nonuniformity; actual intake should combine the irrigation water-use coefficient.
map.净灌水 = (ETc − Pe) × 面积 / 0.667（m³，Pe 为有效降: Net irrigation = (ETc - Pe) x area / 0.667 (m3, Pe is effective rainfall mm).
map.按旬/月 ETc 滚动编制灌溉计划。: Build rolling irrigation plans by ten-day or monthly ETc.
map.用于旱区限额供水下的配水。: Used for water allocation under limited supply in arid areas.
map.某旬 ETc 40 mm、有效降雨 10 mm，净需水 30 mm = 20 m: One ten-day period ETc 40 mm, effective rainfall 10 mm, net demand 30 mm = 20 m3/mu. 100 mu needs 2000 m3 that period; at 80 m3/h pump it takes 25 h, split into morning and evening to avoid high-temperature evaporation.
map.有效降雨为什么不等于实际降雨？: Why is effective rainfall not equal to actual rainfall?
map.部分降雨径流流失或深层渗漏不被作物利用。有效降雨 Pe 通常取实际降雨的某个比例: Part of rainfall runs off or percolates deep and is not used by crops. Effective rainfall Pe is usually a fraction of actual rainfall or a threshold method (e.g., daily rain above a value is excess and invalid).
map.清晨或傍晚地温低、蒸发小、风小，且避免中午高温灼叶。滴灌可全天但仍是低蒸发时段效: Early morning or evening has low soil temperature, low evaporation, and little wind, and avoids midday leaf scorch. Drip can run all day but is still most efficient in low-evaporation periods.
map.根据参考蒸散发（ET₀）、作物系数（Kc）、种植面积、估算天数与有效降雨，计算作: From reference evapotranspiration (ET0), crop coefficient (Kc), planting area, estimation days, and effective rainfall, compute crop water demand and net irrigation volume to help plan irrigation.
map.内置常见作物 Kc 快速选择: Built-in quick Kc selection for common crops
map.支持自定义作物系数与 ET₀: Supports custom crop coefficient and ET0
map.自动扣除有效降雨，输出净灌溉水量: Auto-deducts effective rainfall and outputs net irrigation volume
map.滴灌、喷灌系统用水量预算: Drip and sprinkler system water budgeting
